finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 114 dep bumps, 73 refactors. One real feature.

Three breaking changes hide in `refactor` commits. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from 5 modules. `refactor(api): drop the unused v1 export route` deletes a route. `fix(auth)` now returns 401, not 403, for an expired token.

Added: webhook retry with backoff. Fixed: 9 items, best of them is `fix(db): stop logging the whole request body`.

Two calls to check. I left 10 `perf` commits out since your shape has no heading for them. And `docs: note the minimum node version` plus `ci: run the suite on node 22` hint at a Node floor bump I could not confirm.

Next: confirm the Node floor in `package.json` engines, then set the date if it slips past 2026-08-30.
